props.name: onJumpToReply
props.description:
Pressing the quote; defaults to scrolling to `[data-message-id]` in the same thread and flashing it. The quote of a
deleted message (`replyTo.kind` "deleted") is not pressable.

props.name: holdActions
props.description:
Hold to react (Figma Chat/Bubble/Focused/*, mobile): a long press, right-click, or Shift+F10 / the Menu key on the focused
message opens a blurred layer with the Reaction-Bar above the bubble and these actions below it (Popover/Default).
On desktop (ChatThread device="desktop") the same actions live in the Hover toolbar; right-click / Shift+F10 opens its More menu.
Use `chatHoldActions` for the Figma sets: their built-in labels show in the ZenProvider locale, your own labels as written.

props.description: Your reaction to this message (selected in the Reaction-Bar); `onReact` enables the bar.

props.name: onMoreReactions
props.description: Reaction-Bar "+": open a full emoji picker.

components.name: ChatComposer
components.description:
Figma Chat-Control (6182:56819): Surface bar, padding 8, gap 8. Actions are flat Neutral/Strongest icons — Mobile
Nav-Action/Icon-Flat 44px (icon 24), Desktop Button/Icon-Flat Medium 40px (icon 20). The pill field is
Input/Background/Default + Effect/Input with Body/Base/Medium text ("Aa" in Placeholder); State=Focused only adds the
Accent caret, the field itself does not change. The trailing quick action becomes Send while typing (same flat style).

components.name: ChatThread
components.description:
Opens at the latest message and stays pinned to the bottom when new messages arrive — unless the reader has scrolled up
(more than 48px from the bottom), in which case their position is kept. It pins again whenever the messages change size
after the first layout (a ResizeObserver on the thread and its messages: web fonts settling, photos decoding, a reaction
row appearing) and once `document.fonts.ready` resolves, so a thread never opens a few pixels above its last message.

props.name: device
props.description: Figma Device: text caps at 220 (Mobile) / 516 (Desktop), photo grids at 260 / 400.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the thread; defaults to the locale's "Messages".

components.name: ChatConversationItem
components.description:
Figma Chat/Conversation-List/List-Item (7522:371057 · content 6331:34480), composed from ListItem: 40px avatar,
Title (Body/Base/Bold when unread, Medium when read) · "•" · time (Body/Small/Regular, Neutral/Light), then the
Subtitle — unread text Body/Small/Bold Strongest + a 12px Positive "Active" status dot; read text Regular Light;
a missed call is Negative/Light (Medium) with its 16px icon while unread, Neutral/Light once read; an ongoing call is
Positive/Light.

props.name: group
props.description: A group conversation shows two overlapping avatars (Figma Chat/Avatar-Group).

props.name: preview
props.description: Last message (State=Text). Ignored when `call` is set.

props.name: call
props.description: Last activity was a call (State=Audio Missed Call · Video Missed Call · Audio In/Out-Call · Ongoing-Call).

props.name: callLabel
props.description: Override the call label (the locale's "Missed call", "Audio call", "Ongoing call…").

components.name: ChatComposerReply
components.description: In the composer: the "Replying to …" bar above the field, with × to cancel.

components.name: ChatReplyQuote
components.description:
In the thread: the quote above a reply bubble. `side` is the reply's side (it aligns with the reply);
`replier` names who replied ("You" for your own replies) for the caption. Pressing the quote jumps to the original
(`onJump`, or scroll + flash in the same thread); the quote of a deleted message ("Message unavailable") is plain
text with no hover, since there is nothing to jump to.

components.name: ChatEmojiPicker
components.description:
The Reaction-Bar "+" panel (no Figma frame exists, so it is built from the bar's own tokens): the same Popover surface
as Chat/Reaction-Bar (90% Popover fill + Effect/Popover, radius Large), a back chevron, a search field and an 8-column
grid of 36px emoji buttons (the Reaction/Emoji/Interactive size). Arrow keys move through the grid, Home/End jump,
Enter/Space picks, Escape (handled by the popover) closes.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the panel (the locale's "Choose a reaction" by default).

props.name: mine
props.description: Your reaction (ChatMessage `reaction`): listed first as "You".

props.name: onRemoveMine
props.description: Pressing the "You" row removes your reaction (ChatMessage passes `onReact(undefined)`).

props.name: anchorRef
props.description: The pill: anchors the desktop Popover and finds the device frame's overlay root on mobile.

components.name: ChatBubble
components.description: Figma Chat/Bubble/Text-You · Text-Others: padding 12 (+4 text inset), Body/Base/Regular; the tail corner is 4px.

components.name: ChatFile
components.description:
Figma Chat/Bubble/File (6182:57708): 220 wide, padding 12; a Small Dock-Icon by type (Doc blue · PDF red · Sheet green Solid,
Others Neutral Subtle) + a 32px text column: name (Body/Base/Bold) and size (Body/Small/Regular). In a Business message the
card is Bubble-Chat-Others-Business (radius 16) and the time sits beside the size. In the mobile (and Popular) type scale
the text column hugs its 24 + 20 lines (min Image-Size/Small) instead of Figma's fixed 32px box, so they keep the 12px inset.

components.name: ChatCall
components.description:
Figma Chat/Bubble/Call (6349:59813): 220 wide, padding 8; a 40px row (padding 4, gap 8) of a Small Dock-Icon with the
solid call glyph (Red Solid only for an incoming missed call, else Neutral Subtle) + title/duration, then a full-width
Small action: Social = Button/Overlay Inverse; Business = Button/Flat Primary, on missed calls only (the card is
Bubble-Chat-Others-Business, radius 16, and the time sits beside the duration). Never a Secondary button.
Without an action (a ringing call, an answered Business call) the text column hugs its lines (min Image-Size/Small 32)
instead of Figma's fixed 32px box, so the text keeps the 12px a text bubble keeps below its last line (Padding/XSmall 8 +
the row's Padding/2XSmall 4) in every typography mode. With an action the 32px box stays in Figma's 20/16 scale and hugs
in the mobile (and Popular) type scale, so the lines never spill toward the action.

props.name: actionLabel
props.description: The action's text (the locale's Call back / Call again / Send voice message by default).

components.name: ChatPhotos
ChatReactions
components.description:
Figma Chat/Reaction/Status: the pill on a bubble (total + up to 3 emojis). When it knows who reacted (`by`, or your
own `mine`), it is a button that opens the "Reactions" panel (ChatReactorsPanel): tabs by emoji and the people.
It stops pointer/key events so pressing it never starts the message's hold-to-react.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the bar; defaults to the locale's "React".

props.name: onMore
props.description: Figma Reaction-Bar "+": replace the built-in emoji panel with your own full picker.

components.name: ChatReadList
components.description: Figma Chat/Section/Read-List (6101:61545): 20px avatars (gap 4); more than 5 shows "+N".

components.name: ChatDateDivider
components.description: Figma Chat/Section Time (7042:24411): a centred Caption/Regular Neutral/Light time stamp between runs ("Sat 17:55") — no rules.

components.name: ChatAvatarGroup
components.description:
Figma Chat/Avatar-Group (6340:46191): two overlapping photo avatars on the diagonal — Medium 40px frame with 28px
 avatars (conversation list), Small 32px with 20px avatars (compact rows, thread headers). Decorative: name the
 conversation in the surrounding text.

props.name: size
props.description: Short (sm, md…) or Figma (small, medium…) spelling.
